snippet.title: Soulflame - Official Gameplay Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4177660/Soulflame/

Soulflame is an upcoming action adventure game with precision platformers and metriodvania like elements!

Synopsis:
Orphan Keira Eldrid lives alone with her sister in a small town on the edge of the ancient forest. One day, on a short trip into the woods, something attacks the town she grew up in and kidnaps her sister.

To get her back, Keira will have to harness the power of the forest and master new abilities -- all while connecting with her inner self.

Soulflame is a action adventure story set in a fantasy forest, filled with creatures from cute to terrifying. Uncover lost history, learn new skills and platform your way to answers in this story about loss, revenge and acceptance.

A Game by Alex Eckardt
